title: Identifiability of Parent Registration Data
description: The registration flow collects multiple PII elements (email, name, govt ID) that can be used to identify the parent user. This data is transmitted to the authentication service where it could be linked to the individual.
assumptions: The authentication service stores and processes this data in a manner that maintains identifiability.

title: User data in JWT may be identifiable
description: The JWT token transmitted from the Authentication Service to the Parent User contains user data that could potentially identify the user to unauthorized parties or be used for profiling.
assumptions: JWT contains personally identifiable information or data that can be linked to the user
uncertainty_note: Tree node I.1.1 is a general identifiability node; specific JWT structure not known

title: User data disclosure during transmission
description: User data transmitted via JWT from Authentication Service to Parent User may be disclosed to unauthorized parties if the transmission channel is not properly secured.
assumptions: Transmission channel may not be end-to-end encrypted or may be intercepted
uncertainty_note: Assuming standard JWT transmission without additional security measures

title: JWT token usurpation/impersonation
description: The JWT token containing user data could be stolen or intercepted, allowing an attacker to impersonate the user when communicating with the Parent User.
assumptions: JWT token is transmitted in a way that could be intercepted or stolen
uncertainty_note: Severity high due to potential for account takeover; likelihood depends on transmission security

title: JWT token data integrity compromise
description: The JWT token containing user data could be tampered with during transmission, leading to unauthorized modification of user data before it reaches the Parent User.
assumptions: JWT is not cryptographically signed or is signed with weak keys
uncertainty_note: Likelihood low assuming standard JWT security practices, but still a valid threat category

title: Child login linked to parent identity
